data_boundary.ecosystem_classification: primary repository ecosystem normalized from repo.mainLanguage
data_boundary.ndc_ecosystem_classification: detector-observable dependency ecosystem derived from recognized npm/yarn/pnpm and pip/pipenv/poetry/uv installation operations
data_boundary.ndc_eligibility_definition: at least one recognized non-auxiliary dependency-install operation, excluding warm-cache workflows and jobs containing review-only nested custom setup actions

workflow_role_classification.method: adapted from Bouzenia and Pradel's job-task classification: lowercase Job ID/name labels, remove parenthesized details, and match the simplified task token as a substring
workflow_role_classification.primary_role_definition: workflow-level aggregation of Job task categories; a single recognized category is inherited, multiple recognized categories yield mixed, and unmatched Jobs yield other when no recognized category exists
workflow_role_classification.functional_role_definition: set of distinct recognized Job task categories in the workflow; this is a workflow-level adaptation of the source Job analysis

repository_concentration.method: aggregate successfully scanned workflows by repository; compare the repository-level any-smell indicator with the workflow-level indicator, and stratify by observed workflows per repository
repository_concentration.repository_exposure_definition: at least one successfully scanned workflow in the repository contains at least one formal smell
repository_concentration.within_repository_fraction_definition: smelly successfully scanned workflows divided by successfully scanned workflows in the repository

trigger_distribution.category_definition: trigger categories are not mutually exclusive

ecosystem_distribution.category_definition: ecosystem is a mutually exclusive normalization of repo_info.jsonl repo.mainLanguage; it is a repository-level ecosystem proxy rather than a claim that every workflow uses only one language

non_ndc_ecosystem_distribution.category_definition: mutually exclusive normalization of repo_info.jsonl repo.mainLanguage; the denominator is all successfully scanned workflows in each ecosystem

ndc_ecosystem_distribution.category_definition: detector-observable dependency-install ecosystems; npm-compatible and Python-compatible rows may overlap for mixed-ecosystem workflows
ndc_ecosystem_distribution.eligibility_definition: at least one recognized non-auxiliary dependency-install operation, excluding warm-cache workflows and jobs containing review-only nested custom setup actions

primary_role.category_definition: primary_role is mutually exclusive and selected by a fixed priority

functional_role.category_definition: functional_roles is multi-label; one workflow may contribute to several roles

repository_concentration_distributions.unit: successfully scanned logical workflow and observed repository

definitions.repository_exposure: a repository is exposed if at least one successfully scanned workflow contains at least one formal smell
definitions.workflow_exposure: a workflow is exposed if it contains at least one formal smell
definitions.within_repository_smell_fraction: smelly workflow count divided by successfully scanned workflow count within the repository
definitions.workflow_count_strata: number of successfully scanned workflows observed per repository, not repo_info metadata workflow_count
